description: Represents a named range within a workbook. Can be scoped to the entire workbook or a specific sheet.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: The name of the range. Must start with a letter or underscore, contain no spaces, and not collide with A1 references.

properties.name: RefersTo
properties.description: The formula or reference the name resolves to (e.g. '=Sheet1!A1:B10').

properties.name: SheetIndex
properties.description: When Scope is Sheet, the zero-based sheet index.

properties.name: Comment
properties.description: Optional comment describing the named range.

examples.title: Define a workbook-scoped named range
